segments.opening_question_spark: Surrounded by water, how could thirst still be your first big problem?
segments.entry_transition: All that seawater is not the fresh water your body needs.
segments.body_01: Seawater has too much salt for your body.
segments.body_02: Your kidneys use water to remove that salt.
segments.body_03: Drink seawater, and you may lose more water than you gain.
segments.body_04: Rain can help if you collect it.
segments.body_05: Some islands have springs or fresh groundwater.
segments.body_06: Others may have no reliable fresh water.
segments.body_07: Desalination can turn seawater into fresh water.
segments.body_08: But it needs equipment, energy, and care.
segments.body_09: Food, injury, disease, and aging still matter.
segments.optional_closing: Even perfect fresh water cannot make island life last forever.
